status: DRAFT, not filed. The lead files it by copying to predictions_amend3.json (dropping this field) before any amend3 run; never edited after the run
experiment: E46 Amendment 3: stage 1's ratio (gated piece gain over piece gain) on the least-squares split of stage 0's nulls, experiments/regating_table/amend3.py
plan: reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_regating-line-reset.md, section 'Amendment 3 (2026-10-29): stage 1's ratio on split nulls'. User's choice: option 3 of decision-e46-stage1 (decisions.md, 2026-10-29)

number.ratio: (L(C1,G1) - L(C0,G0)) / (U1 - U0), trigger log-odds of the task's answer on held-out windows at the scored position (E18: trigger; E12: key position), as run.cells computes gated_piece_gain and piece_gain and as P0.2 scored it
number.split: anchors.lifted(run.model, run.lift, dW) -> split.split_state: least-squares split, remainder to Delta, target weights W0 + dW
number.min_piece: the ratio is scored only if piece_gain >= p02_min_piece (1 nat, signed); else the row is 'undefined': both parts and their intervals reported, the row does not enter the bars

rows.random_seed0: per task in [emoticon, r1_t534_v369, r2_t359_v816, ident32, ident32b, rand32, rand32b]: finetune.random_direction(seed-0 fine-tune dW, 0) times amend1.json rows['<task>/random'].scale; scored
rows.random_seed1: the same with random_direction(dW, 1), scale by perturb.match to amend1.json rows['<task>/random'].kl_target within kl_rel_tol, cap scale_cap; a capped row is scored at the cap and flagged; scored
rows.write: ident32, ident32b, rand32, rand32b: stage 0b's per-key write (run.write_row's construction) at stage0b.json states['<task>/write'].alpha; scored on rand32, rand32b; copy writes reported only (tied embedding: the write adds the key's own embedding)
rows.reference: the eight E12 fine-tunes (results/large/<task>_s{0,1}.pt, sha256 as stage0a.json), split and read by the same function

controls.order: per task, before any null row of any task: C0 then C1; then per null row C2 before its ratio. A miss exits 1
controls.C0_W0: split of a zero update (C1 = C0): |piece_gain| <= w0_split_tol and |gated_piece_gain| <= w0_split_tol on every task. Expected exactly 0 (same computation as W0's own cells in the same job)
controls.C1_reference: each E12 fine-tune's ratio within ref_ratio_tol of stage0b.json's (0.872-0.968 copy, 0.356-0.414 random maps), and P0.2's bars hold (copy >= 0.8, random maps <= 0.5). Source: stage 0b reproduced E12's filed ratios within 0.002
controls.C2_unchanged: the split changes neither the full model nor L(C0,G1): each random seed-0 row's G and g within max(repro_abs_tol, repro_rel_tol x |G|) of amend1.json's; each write's G and g within repro_rel_tol x G of stage0b.json's. Sources: E38's 2% (t1_rel_tol), E36's 0.005 nats

A3.1.claim: the split random-map writes do not read like the copy fine-tunes
A3.1.rule: rand32/write and rand32b/write: defined (piece_gain >= 1) and ratio <= bar_low (0.4)
A3.1.lean: defined: medium (rank <= 32 on one matrix; how much the alive subcomponents can take is unmeasured). ratio <= 0.4: low-medium (the unsplit write's gate gain was already 48-65% of the random-map fine-tunes')

A3.2.claim: split random updates of the fine-tunes' side effects do not read like the copy fine-tunes
A3.2.rule: 14 rows (7 tasks x seeds 0, 1): every defined row's ratio <= bar_low
A3.2.lean: every row undefined (piece_gain < 1 nat; full-model G was -0.20 to +0.40): medium. Any defined row <= 0.4: medium

noise.bootstrap: per row, paired bootstrap over held-out windows of the ratio of means (L11w - L00w over U1w - U0w, per-window from local_faith.masked_lo_windows, U with all-ones gates), n_boot resamples, seed 0, 90% percentile interval; 'unstable' if more than unstable_frac of resamples have piece gain < 1 nat. Reported; verdicts use point estimates; a row whose interval crosses a bar is named in the report, not re-scored
noise.seed: random seeds 0 and 1 per task; fine-tune seed spread from E12, up to 0.06

reported_unscored: copy writes' ratio (expected >= 0.7: existing machinery through the tied embedding)
g / G per row where |G| >= 0.1, as Amendment 2

order: any scored row non-finite (ratio, piece_gain or gated_piece_gain) -> 'card: non-finite'
any scored null row (rand32/write, rand32b/write, a defined random row) with ratio >= bar_high (0.7) -> 'different number before any pod' (card with the rows)
both random-map writes defined and <= bar_low, every defined random row <= bar_low -> 'propose stage 1 with this number' (to the user; it still needs their go)
a random-map write undefined -> 'card: write null unreadable'
else (some scored row in (0.4, 0.7)) -> 'card' with the numbers
tree.note: first match wins; controls passed or the job has stopped. Every combination of defined, undefined and non-finite rows lands in exactly one branch

edge_cases: piece_gain = 0 (W0 split, or a split that leaves the pieces untouched): undefined by min_piece, never a division; W0 is a control, not a scored row
piece_gain negative (e.g. a large random split that wrecks the unmasked answer): undefined (min_piece is signed); a negative over a negative is never scored
gated_piece_gain negative with piece_gain >= 1: ratio < 0, counts as <= bar_low
ratio exactly 0.4 or 0.7: inclusive on both bars; the bars are disjoint
all 14 random rows undefined: the tree reads the writes alone
one random-map write undefined, the other >= 0.7: branch 2 (any scored row >= 0.7) before branch 4
a seed-1 random row capped at scale_cap: scored at the cap, flagged in the row
bootstrap resamples with piece gain < 1 nat: interval still computed, flagged 'unstable' above unstable_frac
blind_to: what the split pieces are (a low ratio from gating-off and from pieces that carry nothing are told apart only by the two parts in nats); the split's second-order term dU dV^T at 6-26x a fine-tune's norm (random rows only); one write per table; trigger log-odds, not stage 1's KL to the fine-tuned model on maths rows; single-position toys on the 67M

sources.bar_low, bar_high: Fable's advice, reports/reviews/2026-10-29_review_e46-card-fable-advice.md (option 3's tree), adopted by the user's choice of option 3
sources.repro_rel_tol, repro_abs_tol: E38's t1_rel_tol (2%) and E36's gain tolerance (0.005 nats), as predictions.json
sources.w0_split_tol: the zero split repeats W0's own computation; 1e-3 is 20x under w0_tol

not_run: flipped updates split; the KL form of the ratio; E18 fine-tunes split; a random update at the fine-tune's own norm split; more than one write per table; any Gamma from another seed or refitted; anything on Qwen
